blockers.detail: Evaluator boot path depends on socket-capable database access. Direct TCP listen probe returned EPERM, the standard tsx CLI also failed its IPC pipe listen with EPERM, embedded-postgres Unix-domain socket bind returned Operation not permitted, and existing /tmp Postgres sockets were not connectable.
The sandbox saw 37 /tmp Postgres lock files but every AF_UNIX connect attempt still failed with Operation not permitted, so residual host databases are unusable from this pass.
No AIRMENTOR_EVAL_DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_URL, or PG* env was present in this pipeline shell, so the new external-DB bootstrap fallback could not be exercised.

Accessible retrain artifacts, dataset dumps, and feature exports all predate Phase 2 completion; latest retrain-coverage12-20260422T162939Z was timestamped 2026-04-22T17:07:22Z and is inadmissible for corrected-v8 promotion.

The only newer root evaluation-report.json has file mtime 2026-04-23T01:52:16 local, but its payload still says generatedAt=2026-04-20T02:51:40.283Z with seedProfile=smoke-3 and no reproducibilityManifest, so it cannot count as a corrected-corpus witness.
